articles.title: Sing It, and Link Will Play It: The Ocarina of Time Remake Listens
articles.summary: In the Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time, players can hum, sing, or yell a tune into the microphone, and the game will play the matching song for Link.

articles.title: It's Great to Be a Cow in World of Warcraft: Forever
articles.summary: A forgotten tauren ability called Plainsrunning is back in WoW: Forever, and Blizzard boosted it so low-level cow folk can run as fast as a level-40 mount.

articles.title: Jennie Celebrates Sisterhood on 'Someone to Hold' for Netflix's Steps
articles.summary: Jennie's new single 'Someone to Hold' celebrates sibling love on the soundtrack of Steps, a Netflix animated film that reworks Cinderella, streaming November 20.
